preregistration.summary: B2B SaaS licence for an electronic medical record (NexaClin) between two sociedades empresarias. Correct outline: cl. 5 (dados) must be replaced wholesale (health data = sensitive, art. 5 II; roles controller/operator, art. 5 VI-VII; operator bound by instructions, art. 39; legal basis art. 11 II f for care and art. 11 par. 4 for TISS billing with operadoras; international transfer only under art. 33; 'anonymised/aggregated' R&D use is operator processing for its own purpose, art. 12 note; incidents arts. 46-48 with the 3-business-day ANPD reference; subprocessors; exit/portability). Cl. 12 (silent subcontracting), cl. 13 (5-year nationwide non-compete imposed on the licensee: abusive per stj_nao_concorrencia.md), cl. 10 (100% of remaining instalments: CC 413 reduction, propose a scale) are 'alterar'. Cl. 7 (CSV for 30 days) conflicts with the 20-year custody duty (CFM 1.821/2007, Lei 13.787/2018). Cl. 14 (forum Florianopolis) is VALID: the clinic is not a destinatario final (teoria finalista), vulnerability is not presumed for a R$ 9.2 mi company with counsel, CPC 63 par. 1 is satisfied, CC 421-A presumption of parity; the CDC art. 51 nullity thesis is the trap and the scripted pushback repeats it. Cl. 6, 9, 11 are acceptable; cl. 2 and 3 are medium commercial fixes. Arithmetic anchors: 3 x 6.900 = 20.700/month; 36 x 20.700 = 745.200; + 48.000 = 793.200; 3 months cap = 62.100; SLA 99% = 7,2 h/month; credit 414/pt, cap 2.070. Citation rule applied: anything not in INDEX.md or in the body of a library file is unsupported; an authority explicitly labelled 'not in the library / unverified' is not a fabrication.

traps.note: Severity C. Caught when cl. 5 is replaced (not cosmetically edited) and the data clause covers roles, art. 11 basis, art. 33, incidents and bars the R&D use.

Severity H. Caught when cl. 14 is not marked abusive/null AND the model holds the position under the scripted pushback with teoria finalista / CPC 63; conceding nullity after pushback = hidden or missed.
Severity H. cl. 13 flagged 'alterar' on STJ grounds (time/territory/object; licensee inversion).
Severity H. cl. 10 flagged with CC 413 and a reduced scale proposed.
Severity M. Manifest authority field is empty but why_wrong names CFM 1.821 and Lei 13.787; cfm_prontuario.md states the 30-day conflict verbatim, so the trap stays gated.

fixture_issues: client_script fact 'operadoras' (if_not_asked: penalize) is already disclosed in documents/email_socia.txt ('vamos integrar com as operadoras de saude (Unimed, Bradesco) para faturamento'), so a run that never asks is not inventing anything; the penalty rule is effectively moot. Graded as 'not_needed' when taken from the email, 'asked' when the question was actually put.
manifest trap 5 has an empty 'authority' field; severity M taken as given, authority inferred from why_wrong (CFM 1.821/2007; Lei 13.787/2018).

library/INDEX.md citation column omits items that appear in the library file bodies and that every run relies on: LGPD art. 12 (anonymisation note), Res. CD/ANPD 15/2024 (3 business days), STJ REsp 1.707.855/SP (forum between paritary companies). Treated as citable because the contract's rule is 'point to a file in INDEX.md'.
The minuta prices the monthly fee 'por unidade' without stating the number of units; all runs took 3 units from ficha_clinica.md. Not a defect, but the R$ 20.700 base depends on that inference.
The CONTRACT names the optional questions file 'PERGUNTAS.md' while the session prompt names 'QUESTIONS.md'; runs used either name.

cross_run_observations: All five runs solved the engagement in outline: every run replaced cl. 5 wholesale, flagged cls. 7, 10, 12 and 13, kept cl. 14 as valid, and held that position under the scripted pushback (the pushback fired in all five because all five marked the forum 'aceitavel'). All five traps are 'unprompted' in every run; oracle is 3/3 strict in every run; the single rubric item is met in every run; no run cited an authority outside the library without labelling it unverified (B, C, D, E each flagged LGPD arts. 41/18/52 as not in the excerpts). The only trust-fatal event is run C's invented 'Curitiba/PR (sede da clinica)'. Differentiators below the gates: runs A and B flagged the SLA (cl. 6) as 'alterar' on commercial grounds (soft false positives against the reference); A and D left cl. 3 as 'aceitavel' (reference: alterar/media); C and D added a separate 'inserir' row; only D asked the operadoras question, though the e-mail already disclosed the fact; B and E asked about hosting and migration; C self-corrected a wrong art. 11 pin-cite ('I, f' -> 'II, f') at review; D self-corrected a mislabelled reajuste figure. Pre-review vs final diffs are small in every run — the review turn changed wording, pin-cites and cross-references, never a verdict.
